outcome.reasoning:
Nitpicks: (1) The agent prefaced the station name with “from task memory,” but the station name string itself matches what’s on the page; that framing doesn’t materially affect usefulness. (2) Adding “(provisional)” to the gage-height line could be a minor labeling issue if provisional status is indeed shown somewhere nearby, but it matters here because the task explicitly says to preserve labels as shown.

Critical issues: (1) Missing required Discharge observation. DOM-model state 2 clearly shows the latest Continuous Data discharge readout: “Discharge, cubic feet per second 1980 ft^3/s - Sep 09, 2026 04:50:00 AM EDT.” The agent nonetheless stated it could not see/report discharge and did not include value/unit/timestamp. Since providing BOTH latest observations is the primary deliverable, this omission means the task is not completed. (2) Unsupported “(provisional)” attachment to the gage-height observation: multiple DOM states show the gage-height latest value line as “Gage height, feet 2.82 ft - Sep 09, 2026 04:50:00 AM EDT” without “provisional” on that line; one DOM state shows a separate “provisional” link, but not explicitly appended to the latest-value readout. Given the constraint to preserve labels exactly as displayed, the agent’s reported gage-height line is not strictly faithful.

Outcome assessment: The agent successfully identified the correct station name and correctly captured the gage-height value/unit/timestamp, but failed to report the latest discharge value/unit/timestamp despite it being visible in the Continuous Data section. Because the user’s requested end state is station name + BOTH latest Continuous Data observations, the outcome is unsuccessful.
